description: Solar Together Uptake is a dataset listed in Westofenglandca open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by The West of England Combined Authority. This dataset shows the response to the Solar Together initiative at September 2024. Postcodes of enquirers with their uptake status are shown. Coverage: West of England Combined Authority area. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are solar, renewable energy. The portal shows 1,347 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-08-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OGL v.3 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-westofengland-ca-gov-uk-portal.
